# observation result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/observationResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The entity-valued result of an observation — a coordinate set, an instant, a quality value, a quantity, or another entity. For literal scalar readings (e.g. 22.5°C), the [`observationResult`](gmeow-observationResult.md) entity carries the literal via a datatype property (e.g. [qudt:quantityValue](http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/quantityValue) or a module-specific scalar property). Non-functional: a single observation may yield several results in different frames or granularities, and competing result claims coexist rather than collapse.
